query: SELECT i.product_id, (p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "live!" FROM import_run_item i JOIN import_run r ON r.org_id = i.org_id AND r.id = i.run_id JOIN product p ON p.org_id = i.org_id AND p.id = i.product_id WHERE i.org_id = $1 AND r.source = $2 AND i.locator = $3 AND i.state = 'imported' ORDER BY p.deleted_at NULLS FIRST, i.settled_at DESC LIMIT 1
